svg.aria-label: How a batch job runs today. A workflow orchestrator such as Airflow, Dagster or Prefect triggers jobs in dependency order as a DAG. Each job is submitted to a scheduler, which asks a resource manager such as Kubernetes or YARN for machines; executors on those machines run the tasks, reading input from and writing output to object storage. Failed or preempted tasks are simply re-run, because inputs are immutable.

svg.text: task preempted or failed? run it again: inputs never change
